summary: Every part of the promise is present, faithful and in scope: dark glass cards with a 3px project-colour bar, solid pill header per project, same body box as Triage (no left-edge jump), cards not lanes, 720px max width left-aligned, fold + drag/arrow-key reorder remembered via versioned localStorage, no summary/filter pills. Existing click-through, focusTerminal, nested-keydown guard and testids kept; InboxCard.tsx untouched. Reviewer did not open the four card variant files, tests or e2e spec and did not run tests.
